product_overview: Backend insurance engine for TBA WAAD providing member lifecycle management, eligibility checks, pricing/mapping, claim processing, pre-authorization, and benefit policy management via REST APIs.
core_goals: Provide reliable member management and bulk import for accurate eligibility and billing.
Validate eligibility and map service pricing to provider contracts to ensure correct claim amounts.
Support full claim lifecycle: submission, validation, approval, and settlement with clear cost breakdowns.
Offer a pre-authorization workflow to approve medical services before claims are processed.
Expose stable, well-validated APIs and address fragile parameter handling to prevent server crashes.

features.name: Eligibility Check
features.description: Verify whether a member is eligible for a given service on a specific date taking policy dates, waiting periods and annual limits into account.
user_flows: POST /api/eligibility/check with {memberId, serviceDate, providerId} -> Receive 200 with {eligible:true, reasonCodes:[]} -> GET /api/policies to fetch linked policy details -> Receive 200 with policy including startDate, endDate, annualLimit

POST /api/eligibility/check with {memberId (inactive), serviceDate, providerId} -> Receive 200 with {eligible:false, reasonCodes:["MEMBER_INACTIVE"]} -> GET /api/policies to confirm policy state -> Receive 200 with policy showing inactive/terminated

features.name: Pricing & Service Mapping
features.description: Determine the price for a service using provider contracts first, fallback to master catalog price, and flag unmapped services for manual mapping.
user_flows: GET /api/providers/{providerId}/contracts -> Receive 200 with contract price for service code CONS-01 -> GET /api/services/CONS-01/price -> Receive 200 with master catalog price -> POST /api/claims with {memberId, serviceCode:CONS-01, totalAmount} -> Receive 201 Draft claim with price taken from provider contract

GET /api/services/UNKNOWN-SVC/price -> Receive 404 Not Found -> POST /api/claims with {memberId, serviceCode:UNKNOWN-SVC, totalAmount} -> Receive 202 with claim status "MAPPING_REQUIRED" and mappingTaskId for manual resolution

features.name: Claim Lifecycle & Cost Breakdown
features.description: Submit claims, compute deductible/co-pay/net amounts, and progress claims through Draft -> Submitted -> Approved -> Settled states.
user_flows: POST /api/claims with {memberId, serviceCode, totalAmount, providerId} -> Receive 201 with claimId and status:DRAFT and costBreakdown {deductible, copay, insuranceShare} -> GET /api/claims?memberId={memberId} -> Receive 200 with list including the draft claim

POST /api/claims with {memberId, serviceCode:"null", totalAmount, providerId} -> Receive 500 Internal Server Error (known fragile parameter handling) -> POST /api/claims with missing required fields -> Receive 400 with validation error details

features.name: Member Management (Unified)
features.description: Create and retrieve unified member records including support for bulk Excel import (managed by backend service).
user_flows: POST /api/members/unified with valid member payload and auth token -> Receive 201 with memberId -> GET /api/members/unified/{memberId} with auth token -> Receive 200 with member details and linked policies

POST /api/members/unified with payload containing string "null" in required fields and auth token -> Receive 500 Internal Server Error (fragile parameter handling) -> GET /api/members/unified/{invalidId} with auth token -> Receive 404 Not Found

features.name: Pre-Authorization
features.description: Request and manage pre-authorizations for planned medical services prior to claim submission.
user_flows: POST /api/preauthorizations with {memberId, providerId, serviceCode, plannedDate, clinicalDetails} and auth token -> Receive 201 with preAuthId and status:PENDING
POST /api/preauthorizations with missing clinicalDetails and auth token -> Receive 400 Bad Request with validation error indicating clinicalDetails is required

features.name: Benefit Policy Management
features.description: List and view benefit policies and coverage rules used by eligibility and pricing calculations.
user_flows: GET /api/policies with auth token -> Receive 200 with list of policies including rules for deductible, co-pay, waitingPeriod, annualLimit
GET /api/policies with invalid query parameter (e.g., ?startDate=invalid) -> Receive 400 Bad Request with parameter validation error

Overlap between legacy and unified modules
